title.rendered: Discover the Charm of Nerja: A Perfect Day Trip from Villa Los Olivos

content.rendered:
Nestled along the Costa del Sol, just a short drive from Villa Los Olivos (less than 30 minutes away), lies the enchanting town of Nerja. Famous for its crystal-clear waters, stunning viewpoints, and rich cultural heritage, Nerja offers a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Whether you’re seeking a tranquil escape or an action-packed day, Nerja has something to captivate every traveler. Let’s explore what makes this coastal gem a must-visit destination during your stay at Villa Los Olivos.

Morning: Exploring the Natural Wonders

The Nerja Caves (Cueva de Nerja)

Start your day with a visit to the Nerja Caves, one of Spain’s most spectacular natural attractions. Discovered in 1959, these vast caverns are home to awe-inspiring stalactites and stalagmites, as well as the world’s largest column, the towering Cataclysm. The caves also host concerts in their natural amphitheater, providing a unique acoustic experience. Guided tours are available, offering fascinating insights into the geological formations and prehistoric cave paintings.

Official website here: https://cuevadenerja.es/

Balcony of Europe (Balcón de Europa)

After exploring the caves, head to the Balcony of Europe, a breathtaking viewpoint located in the heart of Nerja. Perched high on a cliff, this spot offers panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the rugged coastline. It’s the perfect place to take some stunning photographs and enjoy a leisurely stroll. The area around the Balcony of Europe is dotted with charming cafes and shops, where you can enjoy a coffee and soak in the vibrant atmosphere.

Afternoon: Beaches and Culinary Delights

Playa Burriana

No visit to Nerja is complete without spending time at one of its beautiful beaches. Playa Burriana, the town’s most popular beach, boasts golden sands and calm, turquoise waters. It’s an ideal spot for swimming, sunbathing, or participating in water sports like paddleboarding and kayaking. Numerous beachfront restaurants, known as chiringuitos, line the shore, offering fresh seafood and traditional Spanish dishes.

Lunch at Ayo’s

For an authentic culinary experience, head to Ayo’s, a famous chiringuito on Playa Burriana. This iconic eatery is renowned for its paella, cooked over an open fire in massive pans. The family-run restaurant has been serving locals and visitors since 1969, making it a beloved institution in Nerja. Enjoy your meal with a glass of sangria and the sound of waves lapping the shore.

Official website: https://ayonerja.com/

Evening: Culture and Leisure

Historic Old Town

In the evening, explore Nerja’s historic old town. Wander through narrow, winding streets adorned with whitewashed houses and vibrant flower pots. The old town is home to several historical landmarks, including the 17th-century Church of El Salvador, which showcases beautiful baroque and Moorish architecture. The quaint shops and boutiques offer unique souvenirs, from handcrafted ceramics to local wines.

Tapas and Nightlife

As the sun sets, immerse yourself in Nerja’s lively tapas scene. Hop from bar to bar, sampling a variety of tapas dishes such as boquerones (anchovies), albondigas (meatballs), and tortilla española (Spanish omelette). Popular spots include La Piqueta and El Pulguilla, both known for their delicious small plates and convivial atmosphere.

For those looking to extend their evening, Nerja offers a vibrant nightlife. Enjoy live music at bars like Cochran’s Terrace or dance the night away at one of the local clubs. The town’s friendly and welcoming vibe ensures a memorable night out.

Tips for a Perfect Day Trip

  • Transport: Nerja is about a 30-minute drive from Villa Los Olivos.
  • Timing: To make the most of your day, start early. The Nerja Caves open at 10 AM, and mornings are generally less crowded.
  • Comfort: Wear comfortable shoes for exploring, and don’t forget your beach gear if you plan to enjoy the sand and sea.
  • Reservations: Popular restaurants like Ayo’s can get busy, especially during peak season, so consider making a reservation in advance.

Conclusion

A day trip to Nerja is a journey through natural beauty, rich history, and delectable cuisine. From the mystical caves and panoramic viewpoints to the golden beaches and vibrant tapas bars, Nerja offers an unforgettable experience for every visitor. Make the most of your stay at Villa Los Olivos by discovering the many charms of this stunning coastal town. ¡Feliz viaje!

More info:

  • https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g315917-Nerja_Costa_del_Sol_Province_of_Malaga_Andalucia-Vacations.html

title.rendered: A Day in Granada: Where History Meets Culinary Delights

content.rendered:
Hi everyone,

Today, we’re embarking on a bespoke adventure through the enchanting city of Granada, where every moment promises to be filled with magic and wonder. So, slip on your walking shoes and let’s dive into a day of exploration, starting right here at your home away from home.

Less than an hours drive away from Villa Los Olivos.

As the morning sun casts its golden rays over the terracotta rooftops of Villa Los Olivos, we begin our day with a leisurely breakfast with a traditional pan con tomate. Surrounded by fragrant citrus trees and vibrant bougainvillea, this tranquil oasis sets the perfect stage for the adventures that lie ahead. Sip on freshly squeezed orange juice and savor the flavors of Andalusian pastries as we map out our journey through Granada.

Our first destination? The legendary Alhambra, just a short walk from city center. As we wind our way through the narrow streets of the Albayzín, the ancient Moorish quarter, the anticipation builds with each passing moment. Arriving at the gates of the Alhambra, we’re greeted by the sight of this architectural masterpiece rising majestically against the backdrop of the Sierra Nevada mountains.

As we wander through the ornate halls of the Nasrid Palaces, let’s pause to admire the intricate stucco work, geometric tile patterns, and delicate arabesques that adorn every surface. From the serene tranquility of the Patio de los Leones to the breathtaking vistas of the Generalife Gardens, every corner of the Alhambra tells a story of bygone empires and enduring legacies.

After a morning of exploration, it’s time to refuel with a sumptuous lunch at a local tapas bar, just a stone’s throw away from the Alhambra. Here, we’ll indulge in a feast of Andalusian delights, from platters of freshly sliced jamón ibérico to sizzling gambas al ajillo (garlic shrimp) and creamy croquetas de jamón. With each bite, we’ll savor the flavors of Granada’s culinary heritage, knowing that every dish is crafted with love and tradition.

Feeling satiated and invigorated, let’s make our way back to Villa Los Olivos for an afternoon of relaxation and reflection. Whether you choose to unwind by the shimmering pool, take a siesta in the shade of the olive trees, or simply soak in the beauty of your surroundings, let the tranquil ambiance of our villa rejuvenate your spirit.

As the sun begins to set over the Andalusian countryside, let’s gather for a farewell dinner under the stars, prepared especially for you by our talented chef. With a menu inspired by the flavors of Granada, each dish is a celebration of local ingredients and culinary craftsmanship. Raise a glass of crisp Albariño wine as we toast to the memories we’ve made and the friendships we’ve forged during our time together in this magical city.

And so, dear guests, as our day in Granada comes to a close, I hope you’ll carry the spirit of this enchanting city with you wherever your travels may take you. From the timeless beauty of the Alhambra to the warmth and hospitality of Villa Los Olivos, Granada is a destination that leaves an indelible mark on the heart.

Some of our favourite traditional dishes include:

Traditional dishes in Granada

  • Broad beans with ham: Perhaps one of the most traditional dishes of Granada is the broad beans with diced ham. They are served in a casserole accompanied by a sofrito in almost every restaurant in the city.
  • Tortilla del Sacromonte: This omelette characteristic of Granada and the neighborhood that gives it its name is made from mutton brains, chorizo, walnuts, and breadcrumbs. It’s a dish exclusive to the cuisine of Granada, so you can not leave without trying it.
  • Remojon granadino: Granada’s Arabic influence is perfectly reflected in this dish made with orange, cod, olives, boiled egg, onion, and tomato.
  • Zalamandroña: This cold salad is an excellent option to fend off the heat if you travel to Granada in the summer. It’s prepared with roasted bell pepper, zucchini, cod, dried tomato, olives, and olive oil.
  • Eggplants with honey: This dish is also typical of Cordoba’s cuisine. It consists of eggplant slices fried in olive oil accompanied with cane honey.
  • Pionono: The pionono is the quintessential sweet of Granada. They are made in Santa Fe, a town in Granada, and consist of a layer of sponge cake topped with a cream base.
  • Soplillos alpujarreños: Although these sweets are typical of the Alpujarra, you’ll find them all over Granada. Their origin is Arabic and they are made with eggs, sugar, almonds, and lemon.

Get in touch with us if you’d like restaurant recommendations 🙂

Few useful links if you’re planning a day-trip to Granada:

  • Make sure to book your tickets well in advance (a few months before if possible) on the official website: https://alhambra-entradas.org/?gad_source=1&gclid=CjwKCAjwupGyBhBBEiwA0UcqaH6n_KiyGg4RuFCutVK6lDlTmXZ-zFd_GQaf8fNiYxU-Hysiq7EAEBoCV0EQAvD_BwE
  • Walking tours in Granada: https://www.viator.com/Granada-tourism/d554-r52690515514-s236335811?m=28353&supag=119943411740&supca=12519862735&supsc=kwd-12462784001&supai=505226603727&supdv=c&supnt=g&suplp=1005424&supli=1005414&supti=kwd-12462784001&tsem=true&supci=kwd-12462784001&supap1=&supap2=&supfi=&gad_source=1&gclid=CjwKCAjwupGyBhBBEiwA0UcqaP5hMg19VtwaUPhOrsjtxGFSj8XnNdxAYxsjYgkWlCmMJWfR0O_WDBoCVAoQAvD_BwE

title.rendered: Unveiling the Secret Charms of La Rijana Beach: Your Ultimate Hideaway on the Costa Tropical!

content.rendered:
Hey there fellow beach enthusiast!

Have you ever dreamt of stumbling upon a slice of paradise where the sun-kissed sands meet the azure waves in perfect harmony? Well, let me introduce you to La Rijana Beach – one of our favorite hidden gems of Costa Tropical that’s just waiting to be explored!

La Rijana isn’t just your average beach – it’s a masterpiece. From the rugged cliffs that frame the coastline to the crystal-clear waters that beckon you for a dip, every inch of this place is pure magic. Whether you’re a beach bum or a nature lover, you’ll find yourself mesmerized by the untouched beauty that surrounds you.

But hey, La Rijana isn’t all about lazing around on the sand (although that’s pretty great too!). If you’re feeling adventurous, why not grab a snorkel and dive into the underwater wonderland? Or lace up your hiking boots and explore the coastal trails that wind their way along the cliffs? Trust me, there’s no shortage of excitement here!

The best part? La Rijana is just a stone’s throw away from Villa Los Olivos, so getting there is a breeze! Hop in your car, roll down the windows, and during the 20 minutes drive between Villa Los Olivos and the beach let the salty sea breeze guide you along the scenic coastal roads. Before you know it, you’ll be parking up and ready to embark on your day of sun, sea, and serenity.

Pack your sunscreen, grab your favorite beach read, and get ready to make some unforgettable memories in this hidden paradise. Trust me, once you experience the magic of La Rijana, you’ll wonder why you ever wasted your time at those overcrowded tourist traps. It’s time to discover the real jewel of the Costa Tropical – are you ready?

It is located next to the N-340 road, where there is a small parking lot. Access must be done on foot through a slightly steep terrain. It has a small beach bar open during summer times. It is made up of sand and gravel.

Here is a Google Maps link that gets you from Villa Los Olivos to La Rijana beach: https://maps.app.goo.gl/zYhr3Y8yVyb2eW7G6

And checkout other websites also speaking about La Rijana:

title.rendered: Canyoning at La Junta de los Ríos

content.rendered:
Hey there, fellow adventurer!

Let me tell you about this amazing spot just a short drive away from Villa Los Olivos. It’s called La Junta de los Ríos, and trust me, it’s like stepping into a real-life jungle gym! Picture this: waterfalls cascading into crystal-clear pools, rugged rocks to climb, and all the thrills you can imagine. It’s the ultimate playground for anyone craving a bit of excitement and nature’s beauty.

So, imagine driving through winding roads, surrounded by lush greenery, until suddenly, you stumble upon this magical place. Two rivers meet here, carving out a wonderland of waterfalls and hidden pools. It’s like something out of a fairy tale!

Now, let’s talk about the fun part: canyoning! It’s all about exploring these natural wonders in the coolest way possible. You’ll be rappelling down waterfalls, sliding through natural rock formations, and splashing into refreshing pools. It’s like being a kid again, only way more epic!

Don’t worry if you’re new to canyoning – there are guided tours for every level. Friendly instructors will show you the ropes (literally!) and make sure you have a blast while staying safe. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned pro, there’s something here for you.

But it’s not just about the adrenaline rush – it’s also about soaking in the beauty of nature. Surrounded by lush forests and the soothing sounds of waterfalls, you’ll feel like you’re in paradise. It’s the perfect way to recharge and reconnect with the world around you.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your gear, round up your friends, and head over to La Junta de los Ríos for an unforgettable day of adventure. And when you’re done, head back to Villa Los Olivos to relax and share stories about your epic day. Trust me, it’s going to be one for the books!

Get ready to dive into adventure at La Junta de los Ríos! With its close proximity to Villa Los Olivos, it’s the perfect addition to your Costa Tropical getaway. So, pack your sense of adventure and get ready for the time of your life!

Price-wise, to get access to the Waterfalls, it will cost 5€ per person and 5€ per car.

Opening hours are everyday from 10am to 7pm during summer times.

Here is a Google Map link that will get you there from Villa Los Olivos to La Junta de los Rios: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bWXavcdebL4HAvug9

And if you don’t trust us, here are a few other links talking about it:

  • https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g1069220-d4661477-Reviews-Junta_de_los_Rios-Otivar_Province_of_Granada_Andalucia.html
  • https://www.costatropical.net/almunecar/junta-de-los-rios.php
  • https://www.spain-holiday.com/Otivar/articles/junta-de-los-rios-otivar-granada
